notes: Two fresh runs in owned private Xvfb sessions; only public Rhino APIs and owned-window point-prompt clicks were used. Existing Rhino sessions and the user desktop were not targeted.

The API probe calls TryGetCircle and TryGetEllipse with explicit absolute tolerance 1e-9 on original curve definitions and native parameter domains. Full three-coordinate centers are recorded, without axis canonicalization or model insertion.

The command probe uses the hash-verified shared box artifact from the earlier SplitEdge audit. Its 31 curve families use both one-shot Cen over five persistent modes and persistent Cen alone. Far-origin is API-only because a distant source cannot be captured in the same component-picking scene.

Portable point-prompt inputs omit only the shared box artifact path. Raw responses are compacted without numerical normalization or array reordering. The independent generator uses no native or Rhino output.

Prompt-time camera matrices agree with public WorldToClient within 1e-7 pixels; native admission uses the actual integer click and a 12-pixel radius. Forty-two independently computed native targets drive full ordered geometry/attribute/selection and Undo/Redo replay, at absolute 1e-9 and relative 1e-10. No recorded result point drives native snapping.

Positive x8, negative x-8 and positive x1e200 common gauges are recognized by Rhino's API but miss its interactive Center snap. Native geometry-invariant centers are retained; these six point-prompt records remain differences.

Rhino's centers drift on short arcs; on the shortest input its API reports x=4.005758751265903 while its interactive command splits at x=2.5000013131935046. Native exact quadratic centers stay within 1e-9 of the generator's analytic x=4. These are retained disagreements, not normalized matches.
The API misses the far-translated ellipse, while native recognition returns the translated center. API comparisons use absolute-only epsilon so the large origin cannot hide coordinate errors.

All 62 point commands succeed and perform actual Undo/Redo, including the ten nonconic admission misses. Misses compare admission only, not unsnapped constrained-point geometry. Point-prompt records are constrained SplitEdge observations, not unconstrained GetPoint or a proof of unrestricted camera/priority parity.
